# Is your DynamoDB table on the wrong capacity mode?

> Paste a DynamoDB table's consumed read and write capacity from CloudWatch and see what it costs on-demand, provisioned with autoscaling and provisioned at a fixed peak. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/dynamodb-capacity-mode-advisor/)
